query: Resorts World shall deposit cash or bond equal to 5 percent of its proposed total investment by December 31, 2025.

commitment.title: Resorts World New York City bond deposit obligation
commitment.description: Resorts World New York City shall, on or before December 31, 2025, deposit via cash or bond an amount representing 5 percent of the total investment proposed in the application.
commitment.original_text: EXHIBIT 1 LICENSE CONDITIONS All references to laws of New York and provisions of the Official Compilation of Codes, Rules and Regulations of the State of New York ("NYCRR") are to the provisions of such laws and regulations as they exist on the date hereof and as they may hereafter be amended from time to time. Resorts World New York City shall materially perform consistent with the content of its Application and commitments expressed during the Community Advisory Committee evaluative process, as determined or otherwise approved by the Commission. General Conditions 1. License Fee Resorts World New York City shall pay, on or before December 31, 2025, a $500,000,000 gaming facility license fee by electronic funds transfer in accordance with Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law§ 1321-e(3) and 9 NYC RR § 601.1 (b ). 2. Bond Resorts World New York City shall, on or before December 31, 2025, deposit via cash or bond, an amount representing 5 percent of the total investment proposed in the Application, in accordance with Racing, Pari Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law § 1321-e( 1 ).
commitment.amount_value: 5 percent of the total investment proposed in the Application
commitment.term_periodicity: One-time, due on or before December 31, 2025
commitment.notes: The cited license condition does not state the underlying total investment amount in the excerpt provided.

Deposit via cash or bond an amount equal to 5 percent of Resorts World New York City's proposed total investment by December 31, 2025.
Status: UNVERIFIED
The license condition expressly requires Resorts World New York City to 'deposit via cash or bond' 5 percent of its proposed total investment 'on or before December 31, 2025.' A later public statement reports that, as of February 3, 2026, 'two of the three licensees have provided their completion bond' and 'the third [is] being finalized shortly.' That is some evidence that most licensees had provided bonds by that meeting date, but it does not identify Resorts World New York City as one of the two, and it does not directly establish that Resorts World made the deposit by the December 31, 2025 deadline.
Promised scope: Promisor: Resorts World New York City. Intended beneficiary/recipient of the deposit: the State/Commission under the license condition. Location: not separately specified in the queried promise excerpt. Benefit/action: deposit via cash or bond an amount representing 5 percent of the total investment proposed in its application. Material condition: the deposit must be made on or before December 31, 2025.
Observed scope: Observed result: a February 3, 2026 Commission-meeting statement says that two of the three licensees had provided their completion bond and the third was being finalized shortly. The statement does not identify which of the three licensees had already provided a bond, which one had not, or whether any bond was provided by December 31, 2025.
Evidence gap: Need direct evidence identifying Resorts World New York City as having made the required 5 percent cash-or-bond deposit, and evidence that it occurred by December 31, 2025.
Promise evidence: c1, c2
